name: Accretion Disk
desc: A tilted accretion disk swirls around a black event-horizon shadow while bright doppler-beamed hotspots orbit the ring and glowing blobs spiral inward and vanish into the singularity, a lensed photon-ring halo arcing over the top, in spacetime false-color, thermal, wireframe, sumi-ink or iridescent modes.
